title: SSRF to cloud workload identity
summary: Connect a controlled server-side fetch to metadata isolation, credential exposure, and least-privilege analysis without retrieving real metadata credentials.
safety: Never request metadata endpoints, identity documents, or credentials. Use a controlled public callback, architecture evidence, egress logs, and owner-provided inert canaries.

nodes.label: Confirm the server-side requester with a public callback
Review metadata destination and header isolation

edges.condition: Server-side fetching is confirmed and the owner confirms cloud context.
Architecture or an inert canary shows inadequate metadata isolation.
Credential exposure is confirmed by the owner without using the credential.
